records.prompt:
Independent requested-clause grading of one fresh blind-reader output. Read ONLY /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/nemesis/2026-11-04-batch-231507/source-continuation-2026-11-05-01/full-iteration-13/grading-input-manifest-a.json and its listed allowed_inputs. No other reader, other grades, source audits, coverage reports, historical runs, canonical summary, browsing or outside game knowledge. Verify hashes and read complete inputs in chunks if truncated. Assess ALL126 actual IDs once, using the frozen question, fixed key, frozen summary, latest rubric and requested-scope addenda. Independently enumerate literal requested clauses; do not simply trust the reader checklist. Use factual content anywhere within the SAME question response: answer, evidence and requested_parts if they actually assert a rule. A question-label/checklist label or section citation alone supplies no missing fact. Never borrow another answer. A correct quotation cannot retract a specific contradictory ruling. Support labels are not grades. Unasked key context is not automatically required; do not impose historical automatic source-gap deductions. Follow the latest scope clarifications and keep global source/playability limits separate from quiz grades.
Correct: every material asked part resolved, no material false ruling. Partial: asked part omitted or genuinely unresolved without false affirmative ruling. Incorrect: materially false ruling/contradiction, even if other parts or final numbers are correct. Report factual grade and strict requested-completion grade separately. No forced difference. A strict difference requires source_unresolved=true, the exact unresolved_requested_clause actually asked, and an explanation; a global/unasked source limit is insufficient. Flag unsupported guesses separately.
Write valid JSON only to /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/nemesis/2026-11-04-batch-231507/source-continuation-2026-11-05-01/full-iteration-13/grading-review-a.json, preserving source data. Top-level fields reviewer, model, benchmark_version, inputs_read, grading_notes, reviews, factual_totals, strict_completion_totals, unsupported_guess_count, key_source_concerns, limitations, full_core_pass=false. Each reviews entry: id; question copied exactly; requested_parts as your clause/status/reason matrix; reader_requested_parts copied exactly from raw; observed_answer copied exactly from raw answer; reader_support and reader_evidence copied exactly; expected_answer and source_references copied exactly from fixed key; frozen_summary_reference with snapshot path/topic; grade and strict_completion_grade each correct/partial/incorrect; source_unresolved; unsupported_guess; reason. Include unresolved_requested_clause only if a true strict difference needs it. Use scripted copying for unchanged question/raw/key metadata and compute totals from rows to avoid transcription/count errors. If key/source concern exists, flag it without silently changing inputs. Do not rewrite answers, key, summary or rubric. No predetermined score and no complete-core PASS.
